description: Plum-purple floor-length fitted gown with low square neckline and elbow-length sleeves, fine gold woven trim at neckline, bodice seams, sleeves and front skirt edges. Cream shawl with purple/gold geometric borders around forearms, decorated gold-coloured belt with round central fittings and hanging ends, small earrings and rings, brown leather shoes. Both hands visible in front. No headgear, armor or weapon.
